exact_root_contract: For every smooth projective complex algebraic variety X and codimension p, every rational Hodge class of type (p,p) in H^{2p}(X,Q) lies in the Q-span of codimension-p algebraic cycle classes.
question: Can coefficient-preserving simultaneous packaging of a fixed finite signed rational witness by a fibre product of its selected component witness spaces create new first-order base directions and thereby repair the total-class/componentwise cancellation gap?
scope: smooth projective complex family; fixed local Hodge-locus branch T through s0
central rational signed witness already algebraic and denominator-cleared; selected component identities are fixed
local scheme/algebraic-space witness charts pi_i:W_i->T at complex points w_i over s0; ordinary dual-number tangent spaces
first-order only; the proposed coupled object is exactly the fibre product W^x = W_1 x_T ... x_T W_m with its common base projection

no claim about a global fine Chow moduli space, stacky tangent automorphisms, rational-equivalence moduli, changing decompositions, component splitting/collision, higher Artin orders, algebraization, monodromy, degeneration, globalization, or initial algebraicity
candidate_transfer: Replace separate component witness problems by their coefficient-preserving fibre product over T, hoping that the coupled object has a larger tangent image in T than the individual component images and can cover total-class Hodge directions lost to cancellation.
precommitted_falsifier: Using dual-number tangent definitions and the fibre-product universal property, prove or refute im(d pi^x_w)=intersection_i im(d pi_i,w_i). Equality would show that bookkeeping coupling creates no new base tangent directions.
solved_positive_controls: codimension-one Picard/line-bundle geometry, where a denominator-cleared divisor class can be represented by a genuinely different single object rather than a fixed tuple of components
Kloosterman complete-intersection hypersurface geometry, where source-specific flag-Hilbert incidence plus Hodge-locus tangent/dimension control supplies an actual geometric mechanism
transfer_disanalogies: a fibre-product tuple only synchronizes already available component lifts over one base direction
H4d1c-a's total cohomological Hodge condition can exhibit cancellation across components and therefore can be strictly weaker than simultaneous componentwise Hodge persistence
a genuinely coupled moduli object may permit changing decomposition, correspondences, extensions, or a single-object representation not factoring through fixed component charts
first-order tangent reachability does not imply higher-order formal lifting or algebraization
